tagline: A nine-week couch-to-5K plan you tick off as you go — progress stays on your phone.
heroEyebrow: A nine-week walk-run plan for absolute beginners
heroTitle: From the couch to your first 5K.
heroLede: Three short sessions a week, nine weeks, no heroics. Tick every session off as you finish it — repeating a week is always allowed, and the plan has no dates, only order.
privacyNote: Ticks are saved in your browser on this device — no account, no sync, nothing uploaded.
planIntro: Twenty-seven sessions, most of them around half an hour door to door. Do three a week and keep a rest day between each one.
meetup: Group session: Saturdays 8:00 AM at the oak lawn — plan runners welcome from week one.
coachBio: I'm Marta. I started running at 41 with a plan exactly like this one, swearing at a park bench between sixty-second jogs. Three hundred-odd beginners later, my coaching rule hasn't changed: nobody gets dropped, nobody gets shamed, and the pace that lets you chat is the right pace.

Run the plan on your own with this page, or come do your week's third session with the Saturday group — same plan, better company. Stuck on a week, or unsure about a niggle? Email me and I'll adjust the plan for you.

faqs.question: I haven't run since school. Is this really for me?
faqs.answer: Yes — the plan assumes zero running fitness. Week one asks for eight sixty-second jogs with walking breaks, and every week nudges that up only slightly. If a week feels too hard, repeat it before moving on; the plan cares about consistency, not the calendar.

faqs.question: What if I miss a session or a whole week?
faqs.answer: Life happens. Miss one session and you simply do it the next time you are free — the plan has no dates, only order. Away for a week or more? Step back one week and rebuild. Your ticks stay exactly where you left them.

faqs.question: Where is my progress stored?
faqs.answer: In your browser, on this device — nothing is uploaded and there is no account. That also means ticks won't follow you to another phone, and clearing your browser data or using a private window starts the plan fresh. The reset button at the top of the plan does the same on purpose.

faqs.question: Do I need special gear?
faqs.answer: Comfortable running shoes with some cushioning are the only real requirement. Skip the gadgets for now: any phone stopwatch handles the intervals, and even week nine is measured in minutes, not GPS.

faqs.question: What happens after week nine?
faqs.answer: You run your 5K, then you keep the habit: three easy thirty-minute runs a week holds your fitness. Come join the Saturday group session, or email me and we'll plan your next block — a faster 5K or the jump to 10K.
